look: Silkqueen Arachne, a A-rank GKOM variant from the Veinweb Spiders family: arachne with an elegant female humanoid upper body on a giant crystal spider body, fully clothed in silk armour. Family anatomy: giant spiders with crystal-tipped legs and black vein-like silk. Build: large, heavy and imposing. GKOM rank cue: most of the body sheathed in GKOM crystal, natural surface only at the seams; the crystals are black vein crystal. A grapefruit-sized GKOM core orb, near-black with a liquid shimmer, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Dark: violet, black and magenta accents, vivid sweeping shadow smoke, star specks and dark sigils
